en.gameDesc: Write regular expressions to match language descriptions over the alphabet {a, b}. Use Kleene star (*), union (+), and concatenation to define patterns.

af.gameDesc: Skryf regulêre uitdrukkings om taalbeskrywings oor die alfabet {a, b} te pas. Gebruik Kleene-ster (*), vereniging (+), en samevoeging om patrone te definieer.

zu.gameDesc: Bhala ama-regular expression ukuze ahambisane nezincazelo zolimi ku-alphabet {a, b}. Sebenzisa inkanyezi kaKleene (*), inyunyana (+), nokuhlangana ukuchaza amaphethini.
